nodes.name: NiFeOOH Galvanic Corrosion
nodes.procedure: Before the synthesis, nickel foam (3 × 3 cm²) was immersed in a 5 M HCl solution for 15 min to remove the surface oxide layer. Thereafter, it was washed with acetone, ethanol, and deionized water. Subsequently, it was immersed in a solution (70 mL) containing Fe(NO3)3 (10 mM) for 10 h at 25 °C without stirring. The obtained sample was thoroughly rinsed with ethanol and deionized water and then dried in a convection oven at 70 °C. This sample is denoted as NiFeOOH.
nodes.source_text: NiFeOOH was directly synthesized on commercial nickel foam using a corrosion engineering method. Before the synthesis, nickel foam (3 × 3 cm²) was immersed in a 5 M HCl solution for 15 min... dried in a convection oven at 70 °C. This sample is denoted as NiFeOOH.

nodes.name: S-NiFeOOH Hydrothermal Sulfur Incorporation
nodes.procedure: Na2S·9H2O (1 g) was dissolved in 40 mL of deionized water. The prepared NiFe-(oxy)hydroxide (3 × 3 cm²) was immersed in a solution containing Na2S·9H2O. This solution was transferred to a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave. The autoclave was maintained at 90 °C for 24 h. Subsequently, the obtained samples were thoroughly rinsed with ethanol and deionized water. This sample is denoted as S-NiFeOOH.
nodes.source_text: Na2S·9H2O (1 g) was dissolved in 40 mL of deionized water. The prepared NiFe-(oxy)hydroxide (3 × 3 cm²) was immersed... This sample is denoted as S-NiFeOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of NiFeOOH and S-NiFeOOH show only peaks at 44.6°, 51.9°, and 76.6° corresponding to metallic nickel from the substrate.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD patterns in Fig. S1 only show peaks at 44.6°, 51.9°, and 76.6°, which correspond to metallic nickel (JCPDS: 98-026-0169).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show nanosheet morphology maintained for both NiFeOOH and S-NiFeOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images of NiFeOOH show nanosheet shapes (Fig. S2a)... When sulfur was incorporated into NiFeOOH, the nanosheet morphology was maintained in the resulting S-NiFeOOH (Fig. 1b).

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED patterns indexed to (021) and (002) planes of FeOOH for both NiFeOOH and S-NiFeOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns of the diffraction rings were indexed to the (021) and (002) planes of FeOOH... In addition, the SAED patterns of S-NiFeOOH were similar to those of NiFeOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping shows uniform distribution of Ni, Fe, O in NiFeOOH and Ni, Fe, S, O in S-NiFeOOH with sulfur content approximately 4 at%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDS mapping revealed the presence of Ni, Fe, and O in the nanosheets of NiFeOOH... The TEM-EDS mapping images of S-NiFeOOH revealed the presence of Ni, Fe, S, and O in the nanosheets (Fig. 1c). Through EDS analysis, the amount of sulfur was confirmed to be approximately 4 at%.
